#region Usings
using Microsoft.Data.SqlClient;
using SFTest.Entity.TestDb.Coverage;
using SFTest.Entity.Utils.TestDb.Coverage;
using SFTest.Query;
using SFTest.Repository.Common;
using SFTest.Repository.Container;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
#endregion

/// <summary>
/// Runs paged reads through the code generated for the Coverage model against a real SQL Server (GeneratedPagingTests
/// compiles and runs it; it is not part of the test project). The generated readers are sequential
/// (CommandBehavior.SequentialAccess), so reading a column out of order fails only here, on a real database.
/// Writes "PASS name" per case; exits with 1 and the reason on the first failure.
/// </summary>
internal static class Program
{
    private const string _country = "ZZ";
    private const int _regionCount = 25;
    private const int _storesPerRegion = 2;
    //the rows the too-long checks would insert if a value got through: deleted with the others
    private const long _tooLongMarker = -4242;
    //the three rows of the comparison checks: low, middle and high values in every column that is compared
    private const string _compareMarker = "sf-compare";

    private static int Main()
    {
        //in the environment, not on the command line, so a password does not show in the process list
        var connectionString = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("SF_PAGING_CONNECTION");
        Database.RegisterModelConnectionString(RepoLookup.ModelId.TestDb, connectionString);
        try
        {
            DeleteTestRows(connectionString);
            InsertTestRows(connectionString);
            RunAsync().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
            Console.WriteLine("ALL PASSED");
            return 0;
        }
        catch(Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("FAIL " + ex);
            return 1;
        }
        finally
        {
            DeleteTestRows(connectionString);
        }
    }

    private static async Task RunAsync()
    {
        var container = new RepositoryContainer();
        var regions = container.TestDb.Coverage.Region;
        var stores = container.TestDb.Coverage.Store;

        //page 2 of 3: R11 to R20, with the total
        var withTotal = RegionPage(2, true);
        CheckRegions("page with the total", regions.ToList(withTotal), 11);
        CheckTotal("page with the total", withTotal.RecordCount, withTotal.PageCount, _regionCount, 3);

        var withTotalAsync = RegionPage(2, true);
        CheckRegions("page with the total, async", await regions.ToListAsync(withTotalAsync), 11);
        CheckTotal("page with the total, async", withTotalAsync.RecordCount, withTotalAsync.PageCount, _regionCount, 3);

        //the last page has 5 rows
        var lastPage = RegionPage(3, true);
        CheckRegions("last page", regions.ToList(lastPage), 21);

        var withoutTotal = RegionPage(1, false);
        CheckRegions("page without the total", regions.ToList(withoutTotal), 1);

        //a to-many navigation property on a paged query
        var withStores = RegionPage(2, true).BeginNavProps().Append(RegionNavProperty.Stores).EndNavProps();
        var regionsWithStores = regions.ToList(withStores);
        CheckRegions("page with a to-many navigation property", regionsWithStores, 11);
        foreach(var region in regionsWithStores)
        {
            if(region.Stores == null || region.Stores.Count != _storesPerRegion)
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"page with a to-many navigation property: {region.RegionCode} has {region.Stores?.Count ?? 0} stores, expected {_storesPerRegion}");
        }

        Console.WriteLine("PASS page with a to-many navigation property, its rows");
        //the navigation property's result set must not change the page's total
        CheckTotal("page with a to-many navigation property", withStores.RecordCount, withStores.PageCount, _regionCount, 3);

        //navigation properties given with a collection initializer (NavProps<T> is a collection)
        var oneRegion = await regions.ByPKAsync(_country, RegionCode(1), new NavProps<RegionProperty> { RegionNavProperty.Stores });
        if(oneRegion == null || oneRegion.Stores == null || oneRegion.Stores.Count != _storesPerRegion)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"navigation properties from a collection initializer: {oneRegion?.Stores?.Count ?? 0} stores, expected {_storesPerRegion}");

        Console.WriteLine("PASS navigation properties from a collection initializer");

        //a to-one navigation property on a paged query, sync and async
        var storePage = StorePage();
        CheckStores("page with a to-one navigation property", stores.ToList(storePage));
        CheckTotal("page with a to-one navigation property", storePage.RecordCount, storePage.PageCount, _regionCount * _storesPerRegion, 5);

        var storePageAsync = StorePage();
        CheckStores("page with a to-one navigation property, async", await stores.ToListAsync(storePageAsync));

        //an update from changes: GetChanges and CreateChange through Set(change), the same Set clause as Set(prop, value)
        var code = RegionCode(1);
        var original = await regions.ByPKAsync(_country, code);
        var changed = new Region { CountryCode = original.CountryCode, RegionCode = original.RegionCode, Name = "Changed " + code };
        var changes = RegionUtils.GetChanges(original, changed);
        await regions.UpdateAsync(RegionUpdate(code).BeginUpdateValues().Set(changes[0]).EndUpdateValues());
        CheckName("update from GetChanges", (await regions.ByPKAsync(_country, code)).Name, "Changed " + code);

        await regions.UpdateAsync(RegionUpdate(code).BeginUpdateValues().Set(RegionProperty.CreateChange((int)RegionProp.Name, "Named " + code)).EndUpdateValues());
        CheckName("update from CreateChange", (await regions.ByPKAsync(_country, code)).Name, "Named " + code);

        //every date comparison, on a date column (every value is midnight) and on a datetime2 column
        CheckDateFilters(container, "date column", AllTypeProperty.DateCol);
        CheckDateFilters(container, "datetime2 column", AllTypeProperty.DateTime2Col);

        //logging: turned on without a Logger it throws right there; with one, every statement goes to it
        var threw = false;
        try
        {
            Database.LogEnabled = true;
        }
        catch(InvalidOperationException)
        {
            threw = true;
        }

        if(!threw || Database.LogEnabled)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("logging without a Logger: LogEnabled was turned on");

        Database.Logger = LogStatement;
        Database.LogEnabled = true;
        regions.ToList(RegionPage(1, false));
        Database.LogEnabled = false;
        if(_logged.Count != 1 || !_logged[0].StartsWith("SELECT", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"logging with a Logger: {_logged.Count} statements logged, expected 1 SELECT");

        Console.WriteLine("PASS logging");

        //a value longer than its column is refused before anything is sent (SqlClient would cut it to the column's size)
        var allTypes = container.TestDb.Coverage.AllType;
        _logged.Clear();
        Database.LogEnabled = true;
        CheckTooLong("too long, varchar insert", TryCreate(container, new AllType { BigIntCol = _tooLongMarker, NVarCharCol = "x", VarCharCol = new string('x', 51) }), "VarCharCol");
        CheckTooLong("too long, nvarchar insert", TryCreate(container, new AllType { BigIntCol = _tooLongMarker, NVarCharCol = new string('x', 51) }), "NVarCharCol");
        CheckTooLong("too long, varbinary insert", TryCreate(container, new AllType { BigIntCol = _tooLongMarker, NVarCharCol = "x", VarBinaryCol = new byte[51] }), "VarBinaryCol");
        CheckTooLong("too long, filter", TryRead(container, new Query<AllTypeProperty>().BeginPredicate().Where(AllTypeProperty.VarCharCol).Equals(new string('x', 51)).EndPredicate()), "VarCharCol");
        CheckTooLong("too long, update", TryUpdate(container, CompareRows().EndPredicate().BeginUpdateValues().Set(AllTypeProperty.VarCharCol, new string('x', 51)).EndUpdateValues()), "VarCharCol");
        CheckTooLong("too long, function parameter", TryFullName(container, new FullName_Request { First = new string('x', 51), Last = "y" }), "@First");
        Database.LogEnabled = false;
        if(_logged.Count != 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"too long: {_logged.Count} statements reached the database, expected none");

        //exactly the column's size is fine: the read runs and finds nothing
        CheckCount("as long as the column, filter", allTypes.ToList(new Query<AllTypeProperty>().BeginPredicate().Where(AllTypeProperty.VarCharCol).Equals(new string('x', 50)).EndPredicate()), 0);
        if(!string.Equals(container.TestDb.Coverage.Functions.FullName(new FullName_Request { First = new string('x', 50), Last = "y" }), new string('x', 50) + " y", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("as long as the parameter, function: wrong result");

        Console.WriteLine("PASS values longer than the column");

        CheckComparisons(container);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Equals, NotEquals, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEquals and LessThanOrEquals against the middle row's value
    /// on every type that has them (the whole numbers, decimal, double and DateTime, nullable or not), and Equals and
    /// NotEquals on the other types that SQL Server compares. Expected: 1, 2, 1, 1, 2 and 2 of the three rows.
    /// </summary>
    private static void CheckComparisons(RepositoryContainer container)
    {
        var rows = container.TestDb.Coverage.AllType.ToList(CompareRows().EndPredicate().BeginSorting().OrderBy(AllTypeProperty.BigIntCol).EndSorting());
        CheckCount("comparison rows", rows, 3);
        var id = rows[1].Id;

        CheckSix(container, "int", CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.Id).Equals(id), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.Id).NotEquals(id), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.Id).GreaterThan(id), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.Id).LessThan(id), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.Id).GreaterThanOrEquals(id), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.Id).LessThanOrEquals(id));
        CheckSix(container, "int?", CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.IntNull).Equals(20), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.IntNull).NotEquals(20), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.IntNull).GreaterThan(20), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.IntNull).LessThan(20), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.IntNull).GreaterThanOrEquals(20), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.IntNull).LessThanOrEquals(20));
        CheckSix(container, "long", CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.BigIntCol).Equals(102), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.BigIntCol).NotEquals(102), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.BigIntCol).GreaterThan(102), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.BigIntCol).LessThan(102), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.BigIntCol).GreaterThanOrEquals(102), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.BigIntCol).LessThanOrEquals(102));
        CheckSix(container, "long?", CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.BigIntNull).Equals(2), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.BigIntNull).NotEquals(2), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.BigIntNull).GreaterThan(2), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.BigIntNull).LessThan(2), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.BigIntNull).GreaterThanOrEquals(2), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.BigIntNull).LessThanOrEquals(2));
        CheckSix(container, "short?", CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.SmallIntCol).Equals(20), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.SmallIntCol).NotEquals(20), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.SmallIntCol).GreaterThan(20), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.SmallIntCol).LessThan(20), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.SmallIntCol).GreaterThanOrEquals(20), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.SmallIntCol).LessThanOrEquals(20));
        CheckSix(container, "byte?", CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.TinyIntCol).Equals(20), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.TinyIntCol).NotEquals(20), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.TinyIntCol).GreaterThan(20), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.TinyIntCol).LessThan(20), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.TinyIntCol).GreaterThanOrEquals(20), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.TinyIntCol).LessThanOrEquals(20));
        CheckSix(container, "decimal", CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.DecimalCol).Equals(2.5m), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.DecimalCol).NotEquals(2.5m), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.DecimalCol).GreaterThan(2.5m), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.DecimalCol).LessThan(2.5m), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.DecimalCol).GreaterThanOrEquals(2.5m), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.DecimalCol).LessThanOrEquals(2.5m));
        CheckSix(container, "decimal? numeric", CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.NumericCol).Equals(2.5m), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.NumericCol).NotEquals(2.5m), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.NumericCol).GreaterThan(2.5m), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.NumericCol).LessThan(2.5m), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.NumericCol).GreaterThanOrEquals(2.5m), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.NumericCol).LessThanOrEquals(2.5m));
        CheckSix(container, "decimal? money", CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.MoneyCol).Equals(2.5m), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.MoneyCol).NotEquals(2.5m), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.MoneyCol).GreaterThan(2.5m), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.MoneyCol).LessThan(2.5m), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.MoneyCol).GreaterThanOrEquals(2.5m), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.MoneyCol).LessThanOrEquals(2.5m));
        CheckSix(container, "decimal? smallmoney", CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.SmallMoneyCol).Equals(2.5m), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.SmallMoneyCol).NotEquals(2.5m), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.SmallMoneyCol).GreaterThan(2.5m), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.SmallMoneyCol).LessThan(2.5m), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.SmallMoneyCol).GreaterThanOrEquals(2.5m), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.SmallMoneyCol).LessThanOrEquals(2.5m));
        CheckSix(container, "double?", CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.FloatCol).Equals(2.5), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.FloatCol).NotEquals(2.5), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.FloatCol).GreaterThan(2.5), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.FloatCol).LessThan(2.5), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.FloatCol).GreaterThanOrEquals(2.5), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.FloatCol).LessThanOrEquals(2.5));

        var day = new DateTime(2026, 1, 2);
        CheckSix(container, "DateTime? date", CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.DateCol).Equals(day), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.DateCol).NotEquals(day), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.DateCol).GreaterThan(day), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.DateCol).LessThan(day), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.DateCol).GreaterThanOrEquals(day), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.DateCol).LessThanOrEquals(day));
        var second = new DateTime(2026, 1, 2, 10, 0, 1);
        CheckSix(container, "DateTime datetime", CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.DateTimeCol).Equals(second), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.DateTimeCol).NotEquals(second), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.DateTimeCol).GreaterThan(second), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.DateTimeCol).LessThan(second), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.DateTimeCol).GreaterThanOrEquals(second), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.DateTimeCol).LessThanOrEquals(second));
        //100 nanoseconds apart: datetime2(7)'s full precision
        var tick = new DateTime(2026, 1, 2, 10, 0, 0).AddTicks(2);
        CheckSix(container, "DateTime? datetime2", CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.DateTime2Col).Equals(tick), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.DateTime2Col).NotEquals(tick), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.DateTime2Col).GreaterThan(tick), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.DateTime2Col).LessThan(tick), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.DateTime2Col).GreaterThanOrEquals(tick), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.DateTime2Col).LessThanOrEquals(tick));
        var minute = new DateTime(2026, 1, 2, 10, 1, 0);
        CheckSix(container, "DateTime? smalldatetime", CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.SmallDateTimeCol).Equals(minute), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.SmallDateTimeCol).NotEquals(minute), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.SmallDateTimeCol).GreaterThan(minute), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.SmallDateTimeCol).LessThan(minute), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.SmallDateTimeCol).GreaterThanOrEquals(minute), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.SmallDateTimeCol).LessThanOrEquals(minute));

        //Equals and NotEquals only
        CheckTwo(container, "float? real", CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.RealCol).Equals(2.5f), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.RealCol).NotEquals(2.5f));
        var offset = new DateTimeOffset(2026, 1, 2, 10, 0, 0, TimeSpan.FromHours(2));
        CheckTwo(container, "DateTimeOffset?", CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.DateTimeOffsetCol).Equals(offset), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.DateTimeOffsetCol).NotEquals(offset));
        var time = new TimeSpan(10, 0, 0).Add(TimeSpan.FromTicks(2));
        CheckTwo(container, "TimeSpan? time", CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.TimeCol).Equals(time), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.TimeCol).NotEquals(time));
        CheckTwo(container, "bool", CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.BitCol).Equals(true), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.BitCol).NotEquals(true));
        var guid = new Guid("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002");
        CheckTwo(container, "Guid", CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.GuidCol).Equals(guid), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.GuidCol).NotEquals(guid));
        CheckTwo(container, "string char", CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.CharCol).Equals("b"), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.CharCol).NotEquals("b"));
        CheckTwo(container, "string nchar", CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.NCharCol).Equals("b"), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.NCharCol).NotEquals("b"));
        CheckTwo(container, "string varchar", CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.VarCharCol).Equals("cmp-b"), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.VarCharCol).NotEquals("cmp-b"));
        CheckTwo(container, "string nvarchar", CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.NVarCharCol).Equals("cmp-\u00e9-b"), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.NVarCharCol).NotEquals("cmp-\u00e9-b"));
        CheckTwo(container, "string varchar(max)", CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.VarCharMaxCol).Equals("cmp-b"), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.VarCharMaxCol).NotEquals("cmp-b"));
        CheckTwo(container, "string nvarchar(max)", CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.NVarCharMaxCol).Equals("cmp-\u00e9-b"), CompareRows().Where(AllTypeProperty.NVarCharMaxCol).NotEquals("cmp-\u00e9-b"));

        Console.WriteLine("PASS comparisons on every type");
    }

    private static PredicateBuilder<AllTypeProperty> CompareRows()
    {
        return new Query<AllTypeProperty>().BeginPredicate().Where(AllTypeProperty.SysNameCol).Equals(_compareMarker);
    }

    private static void CheckSix(RepositoryContainer container, string type, PredicateBuilder<AllTypeProperty> equal, PredicateBuilder<AllTypeProperty> notEqual, PredicateBuilder<AllTypeProperty> greater, PredicateBuilder<AllTypeProperty> less, PredicateBuilder<AllTypeProperty> greaterOrEqual, PredicateBuilder<AllTypeProperty> lessOrEqual)
    {
        CheckTwo(container, type, equal, notEqual);
        var allTypes = container.TestDb.Coverage.AllType;
        CheckCount($"{type}, greater than", allTypes.ToList(greater.EndPredicate()), 1);
        CheckCount($"{type}, less than", allTypes.ToList(less.EndPredicate()), 1);
        CheckCount($"{type}, greater than or equals", allTypes.ToList(greaterOrEqual.EndPredicate()), 2);
        CheckCount($"{type}, less than or equals", allTypes.ToList(lessOrEqual.EndPredicate()), 2);
    }

    private static void CheckTwo(RepositoryContainer container, string type, PredicateBuilder<AllTypeProperty> equal, PredicateBuilder<AllTypeProperty> notEqual)
    {
        var allTypes = container.TestDb.Coverage.AllType;
        CheckCount($"{type}, equals", allTypes.ToList(equal.EndPredicate()), 1);
        CheckCount($"{type}, not equals", allTypes.ToList(notEqual.EndPredicate()), 2);
    }

    private static ArgumentException TryUpdate(RepositoryContainer container, Query<AllTypeProperty> query)
    {
        try
        {
            container.TestDb.Coverage.AllType.Update(query);
        }
        catch(ArgumentException ex)
        {
            return ex;
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static ArgumentException TryFullName(RepositoryContainer container, FullName_Request request)
    {
        try
        {
            container.TestDb.Coverage.Functions.FullName(request);
        }
        catch(ArgumentException ex)
        {
            return ex;
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static ArgumentException TryCreate(RepositoryContainer container, AllType row)
    {
        try
        {
            container.TestDb.Coverage.AllType.Create(row);
        }
        catch(ArgumentException ex)
        {
            return ex;
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static ArgumentException TryRead(RepositoryContainer container, Query<AllTypeProperty> query)
    {
        try
        {
            container.TestDb.Coverage.AllType.ToList(query);
        }
        catch(ArgumentException ex)
        {
            return ex;
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static void CheckTooLong(string name, ArgumentException error, string column)
    {
        if(error == null || !error.Message.Contains("The value for " + column + " is", StringComparison.Ordinal) ||!error.Message.Contains("Nothing was sent to the database", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"{name}: expected the error for a value longer than {column}, got {(error == null ? "no error" : error.Message)}");
    }

    private static readonly List<string> _logged = new List<string>();

    private static void LogStatement(string table, string query)
    {
        _logged.Add(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The rows: the 14th at 23:59:59, the 15th at midnight, the 16th at 08:00 (a date column holds only the days). The
    /// filter values are at 15:30: only their day counts.
    /// </summary>
    private static void CheckDateFilters(RepositoryContainer container, string column, Prop<AllTypeProperty, DateTime?> prop)
    {
        var allTypes = container.TestDb.Coverage.AllType;
        var the14th = new DateTime(2026, 11, 14, 15, 30, 0);
        var the15th = new DateTime(2026, 11, 15, 15, 30, 0);
        var the16th = new DateTime(2026, 11, 16, 15, 30, 0);

        CheckCount($"date equals the 15th, {column}", allTypes.ToList(DateRows().Where(prop).EqualsDate(the15th).EndPredicate()), 1);
        CheckCount($"date not equal to the 15th, {column}", allTypes.ToList(DateRows().Where(prop).NotEqualsDate(the15th).EndPredicate()), 2);
        CheckCount($"date after the 15th, {column}", allTypes.ToList(DateRows().Where(prop).GreaterThanDate(the15th).EndPredicate()), 1);
        //the 15th at midnight is after the 14th
        CheckCount($"date after the 14th, {column}", allTypes.ToList(DateRows().Where(prop).GreaterThanDate(the14th).EndPredicate()), 2);
        CheckCount($"date on or after the 15th, {column}", allTypes.ToList(DateRows().Where(prop).GreaterThanOrEqualsDate(the15th).EndPredicate()), 2);
        CheckCount($"date before the 15th, {column}", allTypes.ToList(DateRows().Where(prop).LessThanDate(the15th).EndPredicate()), 1);
        CheckCount($"date before the 16th, {column}", allTypes.ToList(DateRows().Where(prop).LessThanDate(the16th).EndPredicate()), 2);
        CheckCount($"date on or before the 15th, {column}", allTypes.ToList(DateRows().Where(prop).LessThanOrEqualsDate(the15th).EndPredicate()), 2);
        //the 14th at 23:59:59 is on the 14th; the 15th at midnight is not
        CheckCount($"date on or before the 14th, {column}", allTypes.ToList(DateRows().Where(prop).LessThanOrEqualsDate(the14th).EndPredicate()), 1);

        Console.WriteLine($"PASS date comparisons, {column}");
    }

    private static PredicateBuilder<AllTypeProperty> DateRows()
    {
        return new Query<AllTypeProperty>().BeginPredicate().Where(AllTypeProperty.VarCharCol).Equals(_country);
    }

    private static void CheckCount(string name, List<AllType> rows, int expected)
    {
        var count = rows == null ? 0 : rows.Count;
        if(count != expected)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"{name}: {count} rows, expected {expected}");
    }

    private static Query<RegionProperty> RegionUpdate(string code)
    {
        return new Query<RegionProperty>()
            .BeginPredicate().Where(RegionProperty.CountryCode).Equals(_country).Where(RegionProperty.RegionCode).Equals(code).EndPredicate();
    }

    private static void CheckName(string name, string actual, string expected)
    {
        if(!string.Equals(actual, expected, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"{name}: the name is {actual}, expected {expected}");

        Console.WriteLine("PASS " + name);
    }

    private static Query<RegionProperty> RegionPage(int pageNumber, bool returnTotal)
    {
        return new Query<RegionProperty>()
            .BeginPredicate().Where(RegionProperty.CountryCode).Equals(_country).EndPredicate()
            .BeginSorting().OrderBy(RegionProperty.RegionCode).EndSorting()
            .BeginPagination().PageSize(10).PageNumber(pageNumber).ReturnTotalCount(returnTotal).EndPagination();
    }

    private static Query<StoreProperty> StorePage()
    {
        return new Query<StoreProperty>()
            .BeginPredicate().Where(StoreProperty.CountryCode).Equals(_country).EndPredicate()
            .BeginSorting().OrderBy(StoreProperty.Name).EndSorting()
            .BeginPagination().PageSize(10).PageNumber(1).ReturnTotalCount(true).EndPagination()
            .BeginNavProps().Append(StoreNavProperty.Region).EndNavProps();
    }

    private static void CheckRegions(string name, List<Region> rows, int first)
    {
        var expected = Math.Min(10, _regionCount - first + 1);
        if(rows == null || rows.Count != expected)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"{name}: {rows?.Count ?? 0} rows, expected {expected}");

        for(var i = 0; i < rows.Count; i++)
        {
            var code = RegionCode(first + i);
            if(!string.Equals(rows[i].RegionCode, code, StringComparison.Ordinal) || !string.Equals(rows[i].Name, "Paging " + code, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"{name}: row {i} is {rows[i].RegionCode} / {rows[i].Name}, expected {code}");
        }

        Console.WriteLine("PASS " + name);
    }

    private static void CheckStores(string name, List<Store> rows)
    {
        if(rows == null || rows.Count != 10)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"{name}: {rows?.Count ?? 0} rows, expected 10");

        foreach(var store in rows)
        {
            if(store.Region == null || !string.Equals(store.Region.RegionCode, store.RegionCode, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"{name}: store {store.Name} has no region or the wrong one");
        }

        Console.WriteLine("PASS " + name);
    }

    private static void CheckTotal(string name, double recordCount, int pageCount, int expectedRecords, int expectedPages)
    {
        if(recordCount != expectedRecords || pageCount != expectedPages)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"{name}: total {recordCount} in {pageCount} pages, expected {expectedRecords} in {expectedPages}");

        Console.WriteLine("PASS " + name + ", the total");
    }

    private static string RegionCode(int number)
    {
        return "R" + number.ToString("00", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
    }

    private static void InsertTestRows(string connectionString)
    {
        var sql = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        for(var i = 1; i <= _regionCount; i++)
        {
            var code = RegionCode(i);
            sql.Append($"INSERT INTO Coverage.Region (CountryCode, RegionCode, Name) VALUES ('{_country}', '{code}', N'Paging {code}');");
            for(var s = 1; s <= _storesPerRegion; s++)
                sql.Append($"INSERT INTO Coverage.Store (CountryCode, RegionCode, Name) VALUES ('{_country}', '{code}', N'Paging {code} store {s}');");
        }

        //the 14th late in the day, the 15th at midnight, the 16th: for the date filters
        sql.Append($"INSERT INTO Coverage.AllTypes (BigIntCol, VarCharCol, DateCol, DateTime2Col) VALUES (1, '{_country}', '2026-11-14', '2026-11-14T23:59:59'), (2, '{_country}', '2026-11-15', '2026-11-15T00:00:00'), (3, '{_country}', '2026-11-16', '2026-11-16T08:00:00');");
        //the comparison rows: low, middle and high
        for(var i = 1; i <= 3; i++)
        {
            var letter = (char)('a' + i - 1);
            var amount = (1.25m * i).ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            var real = (0.5 + i).ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            sql.Append("INSERT INTO Coverage.AllTypes (BigIntCol, BigIntNull, IntNull, SmallIntCol, TinyIntCol, DecimalCol, NumericCol, MoneyCol, SmallMoneyCol, FloatCol, RealCol, DateCol, DateTimeCol, DateTime2Col, SmallDateTimeCol, DateTimeOffsetCol, TimeCol, BitCol, GuidCol, CharCol, NCharCol, VarCharCol, NVarCharCol, VarCharMaxCol, NVarCharMaxCol, SysNameCol) VALUES (");
            sql.Append($"{100 + i}, {i}, {10 * i}, {10 * i}, {10 * i}, {amount}, {amount}, {amount}, {amount}, {real}, {real}, ");
            sql.Append($"'2026-01-0{i}', '2026-01-02T10:00:0{i - 1}', '2026-01-02T10:00:00.000000{i}', '2026-01-02T10:0{i - 1}:00', '2026-01-02T10:00:00+0{i}:00', '10:00:00.000000{i}', {(i == 2 ? 1 : 0)}, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000{i}', ");
            sql.Append($"'{letter}', N'{letter}', 'cmp-{letter}', N'cmp-\u00e9-{letter}', 'cmp-{letter}', N'cmp-\u00e9-{letter}', N'{_compareMarker}');");
        }

        Execute(connectionString, sql.ToString());
    }

    private static void DeleteTestRows(string connectionString)
    {
        Execute(connectionString, $"DELETE FROM Coverage.Store WHERE CountryCode = '{_country}'; DELETE FROM Coverage.Region WHERE CountryCode = '{_country}'; DELETE FROM Coverage.AllTypes WHERE VarCharCol = '{_country}' OR BigIntCol = {_tooLongMarker} OR SysNameCol = N'{_compareMarker}';");
    }

    private static void Execute(string connectionString, string sql)
    {
        using(var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
        {
            connection.Open();
            using(var command = new SqlCommand(sql, connection))
                command.ExecuteNonQuery();
        }
    }
}
